title: RepoAssure AI IDE Repair Workflow MCP Convergence Completion Audit v0.1
objective: Use the test pyramid to audit all four additive artifact-only MCP tools from ADR-0024 as one installed-consumer workflow, verify the twelve-tool registry preserves all existing contracts, reconcile documentation and completion evidence, and close the current MCP convergence slice without adding tools, executing validation commands, or writing target repositories.
acceptance: Audit prepare_repair_handoff, preview_repair_execution, generate_repair_patch_plan, and assemble_repair_evidence_package as one artifact-only workflow.
Prove the twelve-tool registry preserves all pre-convergence tool names, schemas, annotations, and behavior.
Verify unit, real tools/list and tools/call, packed installed consumer, redaction, maintainer review, verification checklist, and no-write evidence remain green.
Confirm validation-only remains CLI-only and no validation commands are executed by MCP.
Reconcile ADR-0024, the convergence contract, canonical docs, operation records, and Autopilot state.
Do not add or rename tools, expose resources or prompts, apply patches, write target repositories, publish, deploy, or change detector or acceptance behavior.
